name: Protected Assault (Su)
body:
Benefit: The magus can expend 1 point from his arcane pool as a swift action to protect himself from an opposing alignment.

This functions as protection from chaos, protection from evil, protection from good, or protection from law, as the magus prefers, but he cannot use a protection that includes an element of his own alignment (a chaotic good magus cannot use protection from chaos or protection from good). The protection can only target the magus, and lasts a number of rounds equal to his Intelligence modifier.
